The Standards Stack

The codes that govern every USA engagement.

USA practice runs the American electrical safety stack as the primary frame. Every deliverable is independently reviewed and signed by a Chartered Engineer (CEng MIE India).

Safety Standard
NFPA 70E
Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace. The American baseline for arc flash and electrical safety practice across every Gulf Coast engagement.
Arc Flash
IEEE 1584
IEEE Guide for Performing Arc Flash Hazard Calculations. Applied on every refinery, petrochem, and data centre arc flash assessment.
National Electric
NEC (NFPA 70)
National Electrical Code. The statutory baseline for electrical installations in the United States.
Federal
OSHA 29 CFR 1910
Occupational Safety and Health Administration regulations on subpart S electrical safety. Mandatory compliance.
Industry
ANSI/IEEE Color Books
The IEEE Color Books series (Red, Green, Buff, Gray, etc.) for industrial power system practice.
Sign-Off
Chartered Engineer (CEng MIE India)
Signed on every deliverable. Where a project requires a licensed Professional Engineer of record in the state of work, that is arranged within the engagement scope.

Five Deliverables

Five disciplines. Five USA deliverables.

The five brownfield digital engineering practices applied across American Gulf Coast refining, hyperscale data centres, and US heavy industry.

Discipline 01
Power System Studies
Load flow, short circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, transient stability across 138 kV down to 208 V. NFPA 70E + IEEE 1584 dual-standard practice.
Discipline 02
3D LiDAR Scanning
Leica RTC 360 brownfield asset capture across Gulf Coast refineries, US data centres, and pharma campuses. Front-end to digital twin handover.
Discipline 03
As-Built Engineering
P&ID, single-line diagrams, isometric piping, GA, equipment lists. ANSI standards aligned. BIM and digital twin handover ready.
Discipline 04
Discrete Event Simulation
FlexSim. Throughput optimisation across Houston Ship Channel terminals, US automotive assembly, and Long Beach port operations.
Discipline 05
Risk + Safety + AMC
HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, SIL per IEC 61511. PSM 1910.119 compliance. 5-year NFPA 70E arc flash recertification AMC retainer.

Statutory Authorities

The regulators we answer to.

Every American engagement runs through at least one of these statutory authorities.

OSHA
Occupational Safety and Health Administration
29 CFR 1910 subpart S electrical safety enforcement. Federal jurisdiction across all US industrial sites.
EPA
Environmental Protection Agency
RMP rule, CAA, CWA overlay on refining, chemical, and pharma sites we engineer.
NRC
Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Applied where engagement touches nuclear-adjacent infrastructure or radiological boundary.
FERC
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
Bulk power system reliability and grid interconnection oversight. Reliability Coordinator alignment.
PHMSA
Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
DOT pipeline safety regulations where engineering scope crosses pipeline corridors.
State PUC
State Public Utility Commissions
Texas RRC, Louisiana PSC, California CPUC, and counterparts. State-level grid and tariff authorities.
Three USA Projects

Three USA brownfield projects. Landmark by NDA.

Identifying details withheld. Engineering substance disclosed. Each carries a named Chartered Engineer signature on the final deliverable.

Case 01 · LiDAR + As-Built
Major Tier-1 refiner · Texas Gulf Coast
Plant-wide 3D LiDAR scan of the FCC unit and adjacent process blocks. 4,200 m of P&ID regenerated from point cloud against legacy drawings. Single-line diagrams refreshed and clash-detection report produced for the FY28 capex plan. Native handover for digital twin build. PE signature: Texas Board licence.
LiDAR + As-Built · ANSI + ISO 5455
Case 02 · Power System Study
Hyperscale operator · Northern Virginia
Power system study refresh on a 100 MW Tier IV data centre expansion. Load flow at peak IT load, short circuit recalc at 13.8 kV main, protection coordination across the N+2 PDU rooms, arc flash assessment on the UPS rooms. Selectivity study on 200+ feeders. PE stamped Virginia board.
PSS · IEEE 1584 + NEC + NFPA 70E
Case 03 · Risk + Safety + AMC
Petrochemical complex · Louisiana
HAZOP refresh on the ethylene cracker unit. SIL assessment per IEC 61511 across the SIS architecture. LOPA on the C2 splitter unit. 5-year NFPA 70E arc flash recertification AMC retainer locked. PE signature: Louisiana Board.
HAZOP + SIL + AMC · IEC 61511

Common Questions

Common questions about USA operations.

How do you deliver in the USA?
Our teams are spread globally and have delivered in more than 20 countries to date. The system and process are completely digitised, including data collection at site, which eases delivery from any location. Where a scope needs people on the ground, a team from the nearest geographic base mobilises to site within 24 hours of demand and the onsite work is delivered to your requirement. Multiple geographic site teams work round the clock to match local schedules. For American work we engineer to NFPA 70E and IEEE 1584 as the baseline, NEC for installations, OSHA 29 CFR 1910 for worker safety, and the ANSI/IEEE Color Books for industrial power, with IEC 60909 and IEC 60079 overlays on multinational deliverables. Every deliverable is authored, independently reviewed, and signed by a Chartered Engineer (CEng MIE India).
Which American and international standards do you engineer to?
NFPA 70E + IEEE 1584 baseline. NEC for installations. OSHA 29 CFR 1910 worker safety. ANSI/IEEE Color Books for industrial power. International overlays (IEC 60909, IEC 60079) for multinational deliverables.
Do you produce English-Spanish bilingual safety signage?
Yes. Standard practice on Gulf Coast refining, petrochem, and data centre work where OSHA right-to-know provisions require.
Which industries do you cover in the USA?
Oil and Gas (Gulf Coast), Power Generation, Data Centres (hyperscale, colo), Heavy Manufacturing, Mining (Western US), Ports (Houston, Long Beach), Automobile.
How fast do you respond to a USA scoping request?
Within 24 hours a named licensed PE is on the line. 45-minute discovery call. Joint scoping document within 72 hours. Full engineering proposal in USD within 7 calendar days.
What is the relationship with VB Group and Wistwin?
VB Engineering USA is the field practice. Wistwin is the sister platform that converts engineering output into a digital twin SaaS subscription. Every USA engagement is structured for native handover to Wistwin.
